'''Fungal rot''' was a disease found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. A man by the name of [[Darovit]] healed a [[Unidentified farmer|farmer]] on Ruusan who had a bad case of fungal rot.<ref name="RO2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fungal rot was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2008]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''.
